detailOne.title: Dihydrogen Monoxide Saving Robot
detailOne.info: I created a robot that registers any plant or human mouth and begins to shoot water at it! In a crowded office setting, people seem to be uninterested in watering indoor plants and sometimes even themselves. My goal was to provide a robot to fix that issue and reinforce a healthy lifestyle.

detailTwo.title: Pay Per Read
detailTwo.info: I was curious about how writers and bloggers were getting paid and found out they weren't getting paid as much through online articles. So I built a software service that allows users to pay for the article and a large percentage of the money goes straight to the creator. In that project, I focused on building up the frontend service of the platform using Javascript and CSS libraries. Before each feature was submitted, I was in charge of functional, performance, and cross-browser compatibility testing before they made it to the final release.

detailThree.title: Slugstore
detailThree.info: I redesigned the UC Santa Cruz bookstore and modernized the design using the Py4web framework. In that project, I built the backend database and manually tested the features in the front end to see if they displayed appropriately. My favorite part of that project was the gratification of successfully implementing the search bar properly which displays a list of relevant products.

detailFour.title: Admin Dashboard
detailFour.info: In my spare time, I help develop websites for incoming UI/UX designers and communicate to effectively deploy a successful website. This kind of opportunity mimics the work environment of the industry and provides realistic expectations in terms of design and layout for both developer and designer.
